    <PageDescription mdxType="PageDescription">
      <p>{`This guide explains how to share datasources between different mobile applications using the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` element. This powerful feature prevents duplicate data downloads, reduces bandwidth usage, and improves overall mobile application performance.`}</p>
    </PageDescription>
    <AnchorLinks mdxType="AnchorLinks">
  <AnchorLink mdxType="AnchorLink">Overview</AnchorLink>
  <AnchorLink mdxType="AnchorLink">How It Works</AnchorLink>
  <AnchorLink mdxType="AnchorLink">Basic Configuration</AnchorLink>

  <AnchorLink mdxType="AnchorLink">Multiple Source Fallback</AnchorLink>

    </AnchorLinks>
    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` element allows one mobile application to reuse data that has already been downloaded by another mobile application. This is particularly useful when multiple apps need access to the same reference data (assets, locations, work orders, etc.).`}</p>
    <blockquote>
      <p parentName="blockquote"><strong parentName="p">{`📋 Version Requirement`}</strong>{`: The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` mechanism was introduced in `}<strong parentName="p">{`Maximo Application Suite (MAS) version 9.2.0`}</strong>{`. Ensure your environment is running MAS 9.2.0 or later to use this feature.`}</p>
    </blockquote>
    <h3>{`Benefits`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Reduced Data Usage`}</strong>{`: Download data once, use it across multiple apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Faster App Loading`}</strong>{`: No need to re-download data that’s already available`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Reduced Storage`}</strong>{`: Single copy of data shared across apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Consistent Data`}</strong>{`: All apps see the same data at the same time`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Better Performance`}</strong>{`: Less network traffic and faster sync times`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Automatic Fallback`}</strong>{`: If source app isn’t available, data downloads automatically`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`When to Use`}</h3>
    <p>{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` when:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Multiple mobile apps need access to the same Maximo object structure`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Reference data (assets, locations, items) is used across apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`You want to minimize data downloads and storage`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Apps are installed on the same device`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`How It Works`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Data Sharing Architecture`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{}}>{`┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Source App (e.g., Technician)      │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ maximo-datasource             │  │
│  │ id="assetDS"                  │  │
│  │ object-structure="MXAPIASSET" │  │
│  │ Downloads 500 assets          │  │
│  └───────────────────────────────┘  │
└─────────────────┬───────────────────┘
                  │
                  │ Data stored in local DB
                  │ App ID: "techmobile"
                  │ Datasource ID: "assetDS"
                  ▼
         ┌─────────────────┐
         │   Local DB      │
         │   (IndexedDB)   │
         │                 │
         │ 500 assets      │
         └────────┬────────┘
                  │ Shared access
                  ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Consumer App (e.g., Inspection)    │
│  ┌───────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ maximo-datasource             │  │
│  │ id="inspectionAssetDS"        │  │
│  │ object-structure="MXAPIASSET" │  │
│  │                               │  │
│  │ <mobile-shared-data-from      │  │
│  │   app-id="techmobile"         │  │
│  │   datasource-id="assetDS"/>   │  │
│  │                               │  │
│  │ Uses shared data - NO         │  │
│  │ duplicate download!           │  │
│  └───────────────────────────────┘  │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Validation Process`}</h3>
    <p>{`The Graphite framework automatically validates:`}</p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">{`✅ Source app exists and is accessible`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`✅ Source datasource exists in the source app`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`✅ Object structures match between source and consumer`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`✅ No recursive linking (A→B→A)`}</li>
    </ol>
    <h3>{`Fallback Behavior`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important`}</strong>{`: If the source app specified in `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`app-id`}</inlineCode>{` doesn’t exist or isn’t installed, the datasource will automatically download its own data from the server. This ensures the consumer app continues to function even when the source app is unavailable.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Basic Configuration`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Identify Source Datasource`}</h3>
    <p>{`First, identify the datasource in the source app that contains the data you want to share:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- In Technician app (techmobile) -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="assetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true"
  page-size="50">
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <attribute name="siteid"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Configure Consumer Datasource`}</h3>
    <p>{`In the consumer app, create a datasource with `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- In Inspection app (inspection) -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="inspectionAssetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true">
  
  <!-- Share data from Technician app -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <!-- Attributes must be subset of source datasource -->
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Key Attributes`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`app-id`}</strong>{`: The ID of the source mobile application (must match the app’s `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`id`}</inlineCode>{` attribute)`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`datasource-id`}</strong>{`: The ID of the datasource in the source app to share from`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>{`Advanced Examples`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Example 1: Work Order Sharing`}</h3>
    <p>{`Share work order data between Technician and Inspection apps:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Source: Technician app (techmobile) -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="workorderDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL"
  offline-enabled="true"
  page-size="50"
  saved-query="ASSIGNEDWORK">
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="wonum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <attribute name="schedstart"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Consumer: Inspection app (inspection) -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="inspectionWODS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL"
  offline-enabled="true">
  
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="workorderDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <!-- Only using subset of attributes from source -->
    <attribute name="wonum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 2: Location Sharing`}</h3>
    <p>{`Share location data across multiple apps:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Source: Technician app -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="locationDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPILOCATION"
  offline-enabled="true"
  page-size="100">
  
  <mobile-qbe-filter>
    {{'status': '=OPERATING'}}
  </mobile-qbe-filter>
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="siteid"/>
    <attribute name="type"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Consumer: Service Request app -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="srLocationDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPILOCATION"
  offline-enabled="true">
  
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="locationDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <!-- Subset of source attributes -->
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="siteid"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 3: Item Master Sharing`}</h3>
    <p>{`Share item/part data for inventory management:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Source: Inventory app (irmobile) -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="itemDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIITEM"
  offline-enabled="true"
  page-size="200">
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="itemnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="itemtype"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="unitcost"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Consumer: Technician app -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="woItemDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIITEM"
  offline-enabled="true">
  
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="irmobile" 
    datasource-id="itemDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <!-- Only need basic item info -->
    <attribute name="itemnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Multiple Source Fallback`}</h2>
    <p>{`You can specify multiple `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` elements to create a fallback chain. The framework will check each source in order and use the first available one. If none are available, it will download data directly.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Fallback Chain Example`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Consumer datasource with multiple fallback sources -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="assetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true"
  page-size="50">
  
  <!-- First priority: Try Technician app -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  
  <!-- Second priority: Try Inspection app if Technician not available -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="inspection" 
    datasource-id="inspectionAssetDS"/>
  
  <!-- Third priority: Try Maintenance app if others not available -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="maintenance" 
    datasource-id="maintenanceAssetDS"/>
  
  <!-- If none available, downloads data directly -->
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`How Fallback Works`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{}}>{`┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Consumer App Datasource                            │
│  Checks sources in order:                           │
└─────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘
                  │
                  ▼
         ┌────────────────────┐
         │ 1. Check techmobile│
         │    app-id          │
         └────────┬───────────┘
                  │
                  ├─── Found? ──► Use data from techmobile
                  │
                  ▼ Not found
         ┌────────────────────┐
         │ 2. Check inspection│
         │    app-id          │
         └────────┬───────────┘
                  │
                  ├─── Found? ──► Use data from inspection
                  │
                  ▼ Not found
         ┌────────────────────┐
         │ 3. Check maintenance│
         │    app-id          │
         └────────┬───────────┘
                  │
                  ├─── Found? ──► Use data from maintenance
                  │
                  ▼ Not found
         ┌────────────────────┐
         │ 4. Download data   │
         │    directly from   │
         │    server          │
         └────────────────────┘
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Real-World Fallback Scenario`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Dashboard app with multiple fallback sources -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="dashboardWODS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL"
  offline-enabled="true"
  page-size="10">
  
  <!-- Try Technician app first (most complete data) -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="workorderDS"/>
  
  <!-- Fallback to Inspection app -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="inspection" 
    datasource-id="inspectionWODS"/>
  
  <!-- Fallback to Service Request app -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="servicerequest" 
    datasource-id="srWODS"/>
  
  <!-- If none installed, download minimal data for dashboard -->
  
  <schema>
    <!-- Only need minimal attributes for dashboard display -->
    <attribute name="wonum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Benefits of Multiple Sources`}</h3>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Increased Availability`}</strong>{`: App works even if primary source isn’t installed`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Flexibility`}</strong>{`: Users can install any combination of apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Optimization`}</strong>{`: Use the best available data source`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Graceful Degradation`}</strong>{`: Falls back to direct download if needed`}</li>
    </ol>
    <h2>{`Schema Attribute Requirements`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Critical Rule: Subset Requirement`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`All attributes in the consumer datasource schema MUST be a subset of the source datasource schema.`}</strong>{` If you request an attribute that doesn’t exist in the source, it will not be available in the consumer datasource.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Correct Configuration`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Source: Has 5 attributes -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="assetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true">
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <attribute name="siteid"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Consumer: Uses subset of 3 attributes ✅ CORRECT -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="myAssetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true">
  
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <!-- These 3 attributes exist in source - will work -->
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Incorrect Configuration`}</h3>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Source: Has 3 attributes -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="assetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true">
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Consumer: Requests 5 attributes ❌ WRONG -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="myAssetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true">
  
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <!-- These 2 attributes DON'T exist in source - will be NULL/unavailable -->
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <attribute name="siteid"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`What Happens with Missing Attributes`}</h3>
    <p>{`If you request attributes not in the source:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`The attributes will be `}<strong parentName="li">{`NULL`}</strong>{` or `}<strong parentName="li">{`undefined`}</strong>{` in the consumer datasource`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`No error will be thrown`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`UI components binding to these attributes will show empty values`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`This can cause confusion and bugs`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Best Practice: Verify Source Schema`}</h3>
    <p>{`Before configuring `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{`, always verify what attributes are available in the source datasource:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Step 1: Check source datasource schema -->
<!-- Source app: techmobile -->
<maximo-datasource id="assetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <!-- Note: siteid is NOT included -->
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Step 2: Consumer only requests available attributes -->
<maximo-datasource id="myAssetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <!-- Only request attributes that exist in source -->
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <!-- Don't request siteid - it's not in source -->
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Multiple Source Fallback with Schema Considerations`}</h3>
    <p>{`When using multiple sources, ensure all sources have the required attributes:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- All sources must have the attributes you need -->

<!-- Source 1: Technician app -->
<maximo-datasource id="assetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="location"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Source 2: Inspection app -->
<maximo-datasource id="inspectionAssetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <!-- Same attributes as Source 1 -->
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Consumer: Can safely use these attributes from either source -->
<maximo-datasource id="myAssetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="inspection" datasource-id="inspectionAssetDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <!-- These attributes exist in both sources -->
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Filtering Shared Data`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Using mobile-qbe-filter`}</h3>
    <p>{`Apply filters to shared data to show only relevant records:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="activeAssetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true"
  mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status': '=OPERATING'}}">
  
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Using QBE Elements`}</h3>
    <p>{`For more complex filtering:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="criticalAssetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  offline-enabled="true"
  mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status': '=OPERATING', 'priority': '>5'}}">
  
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  
  <qbe>
    <qbe-field name="status" operator="=" value="OPERATING"/>
    <qbe-field name="priority" operator=">" value="5"/>
  </qbe>
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
    <attribute name="priority"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Combining with Page Size`}</h3>
    <p>{`For memory optimization, combine filtering with page-size:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="recentWODS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL"
  offline-enabled="true"
  page-size="20"
  mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status': '=INPRG'}}">
  
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="workorderDS"/>
  
  <schema>
    <attribute name="wonum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <attribute name="status"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>
    <h3>{`1. Choose the Right Source App`}</h3>
    <p>{`✅ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DO`}</strong>{`: Use the app that downloads the most complete dataset as the primary source`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Technician app downloads all assets with full details -->
<mobile-shared-data-from 
  app-id="techmobile" 
  datasource-id="assetDS"/>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`2. Match Object Structures`}</h3>
    <p>{`✅ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DO`}</strong>{`: Ensure object structures match exactly`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Both use MXAPIASSET -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="assetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`❌ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DON’T`}</strong>{`: Try to share between different object structures`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- WRONG: Different object structures -->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="assetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="locationDS"/> <!-- MXAPILOCATION -->
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`3. Use Subset of Source Attributes`}</h3>
    <p>{`✅ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DO`}</strong>{`: Only request attributes that exist in source`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Source has: assetnum, description, status, location -->
<maximo-datasource id="myAssetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  <schema>
    <!-- Request subset that exists in source -->
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p>{`❌ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DON’T`}</strong>{`: Request attributes not in source`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Source only has: assetnum, description -->
<maximo-datasource id="myAssetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <!-- These won't be available - not in source -->
    <attribute name="location"/>
    <attribute name="siteid"/>
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`4. Use Appropriate Filters`}</h3>
    <p>{`✅ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DO`}</strong>{`: Filter shared data to show only relevant records`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="myAssetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status': '=OPERATING'}}">
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`5. Set Appropriate Page Size`}</h3>
    <p>{`✅ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DO`}</strong>{`: Set page-size for memory optimization`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="assetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET"
  page-size="50">
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`6. Use Multiple Sources for Reliability`}</h3>
    <p>{`✅ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DO`}</strong>{`: Provide fallback sources for better availability`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource id="assetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="inspection" datasource-id="inspectionAssetDS"/>
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="maintenance" datasource-id="maintenanceAssetDS"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`7. Document Dependencies`}</h3>
    <p>{`✅ `}<strong parentName="p">{`DO`}</strong>{`: Document which apps and attributes are required`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- 
  DEPENDENCY: Shares data from techmobile app (primary) or inspection app (fallback).
  If neither installed, downloads data directly.
  
  REQUIRED ATTRIBUTES IN SOURCE:
  - assetnum
  - description
  - status
-->
<maximo-datasource 
  id="inspectionAssetDS" 
  object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="inspection" 
    datasource-id="assetDS"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Do’s and Don’ts`}</h2>
    <h3>{`✅ DO’s`}</h3>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DO verify source schema`}</strong>{` - Always check what attributes are available in the source datasource`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DO use subset of attributes`}</strong>{` - Only request attributes that exist in the source`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DO use multiple fallback sources`}</strong>{` - Provide 2-3 fallback sources for better reliability`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DO test all fallback scenarios`}</strong>{` - Test with each source app and with none installed`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DO use mobile-qbe-filter`}</strong>{` - Filter shared data to reduce memory usage`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DO set appropriate page-size`}</strong>{` - Use page-size=“20-50” for most cases`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DO document dependencies`}</strong>{` - Document which apps and attributes are required`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DO handle fallback gracefully`}</strong>{` - Remember data downloads automatically if no source available`}</p>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <h3>{`❌ DON’Ts`}</h3>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DON’T create circular dependencies`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<!-- WRONG: App A shares from App B, App B shares from App A -->
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DON’T mix object structures`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<!-- WRONG: Different object structures -->
<maximo-datasource object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from 
    app-id="techmobile" 
    datasource-id="locationDS"/> <!-- MXAPILOCATION -->
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DON’T request unavailable attributes`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<!-- WRONG: Requesting attributes not in source -->
<schema>
  <attribute name="assetnum"/>
  <attribute name="customfield"/> <!-- Not in source -->
</schema>
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DON’T forget offline-enabled`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<!-- WRONG: Missing offline-enabled -->
<maximo-datasource id="assetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="assetDS"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DON’T load all records without filtering`}</strong>{` - Always use filters to limit data`}</p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`DON’T assume source is always available`}</strong>{` - Use multiple fallback sources`}</p>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <h2>{`Troubleshooting`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Issue: Source App Not Installed`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Behavior`}</strong>{`: If the source app doesn’t exist or isn’t installed, the datasource automatically downloads its own data from the server.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`What This Means`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`The consumer app will still function normally`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Data will be downloaded directly instead of being shared`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`No error will be thrown - this is expected fallback behavior`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`If multiple sources specified, checks each in order`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Issue: Attributes Showing NULL/Empty`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Cause`}</strong>{`: Requested attributes don’t exist in source datasource schema`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Solution`}</strong>{`: Verify source schema and only request available attributes`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Check source schema first -->
<!-- Source -->
<maximo-datasource id="assetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <!-- location is NOT included -->
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>

<!-- Consumer - don't request location -->
<maximo-datasource id="myAssetDS" object-structure="MXAPIASSET">
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="assetDS"/>
  <schema>
    <attribute name="assetnum"/>
    <attribute name="description"/>
    <!-- Don't request location - it's not in source -->
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Issue: “Invalid datasource-id” Error`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Cause`}</strong>{`: The datasource ID doesn’t exist in the source app`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Solution`}</strong>{`: Verify the datasource ID exists in the source app`}</p>
    <h3>{`Issue: “Object structure mismatch” Error`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Cause`}</strong>{`: Source and consumer use different object structures`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Solution`}</strong>{`: Ensure both use the same object structure`}</p>
    <h3>{`Issue: “Recursive linking detected” Error`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Cause`}</strong>{`: Circular dependency between apps (A→B→A)`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Solution`}</strong>{`: Remove circular dependencies - choose one app as source`}</p>
    <h3>{`Issue: No Data Showing`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Possible Causes`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Source app hasn’t synced data yet`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`Filters are too restrictive`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol">{`All fallback sources unavailable (should download directly)`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Solution`}</strong>{`: Check each fallback source and verify filters`}</p>
    <h3>{`Issue: Performance Problems`}</h3>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Cause`}</strong>{`: Loading too much shared data without filtering`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Solution`}</strong>{`: Add filtering with `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-qbe-filter`}</inlineCode>{` and set appropriate `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`page-size`}</inlineCode></p>
    <h2>{`Summary`}</h2>
    <p>{`The `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` element is a powerful feature for optimizing mobile application performance by preventing duplicate data downloads. By following the best practices and avoiding common pitfalls outlined in this guide, you can effectively share data between mobile applications while maintaining good performance and user experience.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Key Takeaways`}</h3>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`mobile-shared-data-from`}</inlineCode>{` to share data between apps`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Specify multiple sources for automatic fallback`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ If no source app exists, data downloads automatically`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Consumer schema attributes MUST be subset of source schema`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Always filter shared data with `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`mobile-qbe-filter`}</inlineCode></li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Set appropriate `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`page-size`}</inlineCode>{` for memory optimization`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Ensure object structures match between source and consumer`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Avoid circular dependencies`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Document data sharing relationships and required attributes`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ Test with all fallback scenarios`}</li>
    </ul>
